instruction: Cinematic full shot of a spacious indoor dance hall. The man in the brown shirt and beanie (R1) stands in the center, lifting his partner. The woman in the black outfit (R2) is held upside down, her body arched backwards toward the wooden floor. The man (R1) supports her weight with focused effort. Soft natural light illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows.

R1 supports R2's weight while R2 is held upside down
R2 is the inverted partner with her body arched backward toward the floor
wooden floor beneath the inverted dance lift
soft natural light illuminating the dance scene
